title: Content Marketing Lead, Insights
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The impact you will have:

  • Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.

  • Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.

  • Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.

  • Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.

  • Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.

  • Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.

  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.

  • Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.

  • A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.

  • The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About the Team:

  • You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.

  • The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.

  • It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.

  • The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.

  • Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.

  • Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.

  • AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.

  • Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: None; fully remote.

  • Frequency: None.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.

  • Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.

  • Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

title: VP of Global Growth
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM is hiring a VP of Global Growth to lead our next stage of expansion, building a global growth organization that delivers repeatable, scalable, and efficient growth.

You will own global pipeline generation across the company and the customer journey from initial awareness through to a sales-accepted opportunity. You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, be a key member of our Growth Leadership Team, and lead teams across growth strategy, digital and lifecycle marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, and marketing operations and analytics. You will establish attribution, experimentation, and funnel visibility to understand what’s working, address what isn’t, and guide TRM on where to invest to drive growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the pipeline generation plan. Translate revenue targets into pipeline requirements by market, region, offering, and customer type. Account for conversion rates and sales cycles, agree contributions with other revenue leaders, and own the consolidated plan and response to gaps.

  • Find and attack the bottlenecks. Map how accounts and buyers move from awareness to qualified opportunities, define the entry and exit criteria for each stage, and identify where progress stalls. Work with Sales to improve handoffs and use win/loss results to sharpen targeting and programs.

  • Lead the full demand generation engine. Integrate demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, account-based marketing (ABM), field marketing, and digital into a coordinated strategy that generates qualified pipeline across global pods. Connect events, executive programs, content, and coordinated sales outreach to explicit pipeline goals.

  • Build digital and lifecycle capabilities. Lead paid search and social, organic search and AI discovery, website conversion, landing pages, nurture, and reactivation. Understand how these channels work together and where additional investment can generate qualified pipeline efficiently.

  • Increase experimentation velocity. Diagnose where the growth engine underperforms, prioritize high-impact hypotheses, and establish a fast, disciplined cadence of experiments across audiences, channels, campaigns, and conversion paths. Use AI to accelerate targeting, campaign operations, content production, and analysis while maintaining quality.

  • Build a stunning team and culture. Develop the existing team, recruit critical talent, and set clear responsibilities across shared capabilities and market teams. Own the budget and agency relationships, establish a disciplined operating rhythm, and use AI and automation to increase the team’s capacity and speed.

  • Executive leadership: Serve as the executive voice for pipeline generation, advising the CRO, CEO, and broader leadership team on pipeline performance, investment tradeoffs, and opportunities across markets and customer segments.

What we’re looking for:

  • A track record of owning and growing qualified pipeline in an enterprise technology business with complex buying groups and long sales cycles. You can explain the targets, investment decisions, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes behind your results.

  • Quantitative fluency and sound judgment with imperfect data. You can build a funnel model, pressure-test attribution, evaluate acquisition economics, and design useful experiments when volumes are too small for simple A/B tests.

  • A track record driving both new-logo acquisition and customer expansion, with a rigorous understanding of conversion, acquisition economics, and payback.

  • Deep full-funnel expertise, from awareness and MQL generation through opportunity creation, Sales handoffs, and downstream pipeline outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success building multitouch attribution, marketing analytics, and forecasting models that improve investment decisions and reveal where the funnel is underperforming.

  • A disciplined approach to experimentation, with evidence of increasing testing velocity and translating learning into measurable improvements in qualified pipeline and conversion.

  • Experience leading demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, ABM, digital, and regional or field marketing, supported by strong marketing operations and data analytics.

  • Applied AI fluency: you can show how you have used AI to improve campaign operations, targeting, content velocity, forecasting, or attribution, with appropriate quality controls.

  • A track record hiring and developing leaders and building an operating model that creates accountability across teams and functions.

  • Multi-region experience across NA, APAC, and EMEA, ideally including public-sector or regulated-buyer motions, with the judgment to tailor strategy by market and segment.

  • Strong executive communication and GTM partnership. You can align leaders on the growth plan, challenge assumptions with evidence, and move comfortably between revenue outcomes and campaign detail.

This role may be a fit if you…

  • Have willed extraordinarily ambitious programs and teams into existence

  • Look at a funnel and immediately hypothesize about bottlenecks and experiments to run

  • Are as energized by developing a market strategy as you are by building a campaign, rewriting a landing page, or fixing a broken handoff

  • Experiment constantly with AI and find yourself teaching others how to uplevel their usage

  • Need to be at a company where you can draw a straight line from the work you do to a positive impact in your community

title: Principal Software Engineer - Product Platforms
description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help define and build shared, API-first product platforms at AlphaSense that power multiple product surfaces, integrations, and agentic workflows.

In this role, you’ll focus on building platforms as products: well-designed APIs, clear contracts, strong reliability guarantees, and a roadmap driven by real product needs. These platforms are consumed by internal product teams, external integrations, including AI agents.

This role sits at the intersection of hands-on engineering and cross-product technical leadership. You’ll stay close to the code while shaping how product platforms are designed, evolved, and adopted across the company. You’ll also work across multiple teams and domains, helping to align long-term technical direction while still owning end-to-end systems. This is not a people-management role, nor is it a purely advisory architecture role. We’re explicitly looking for a Principal who enjoys building, prototyping, iterating, and solving complex problems in production.

What You’ll Do:

  • Act as a technical owner and force multiplier for API-first architecture across the company
  • Design, build, and evolve high-scale APIs used by internal teams, external customers, and intelligent agents
  • Lead the development of agentic workflows, including orchestration, state management, tooling, and integration patterns
  • Drive API standards, design principles, and best practices through hands-on work and technical reviews
  • Tackle complex cross-team problems where requirements are ambiguous, and constraints are real
  • Partner with Product, Platform, and SRE teams to ensure APIs are reliable, observable, secure, and scalable
  • Identify and reduce systemic technical risks while enabling teams to move faster
  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar through example, not hierarchy

Who you are:

  • Extensive experience as a senior staff/principal-level software engineer working on applications and backend systems
  • Experience building product platforms or shared services consumed by multiple product teams
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and operating APIs at scale
  • Strong hands-on experience with RESTful APIs
  • Some experience with GraphQL (design, usage, or operating in production)
  • Deep understanding of system design, performance, reliability, and evolution over time
  • Strong bias toward hands-on contribution and ownership of real systems
  • Ability to influence technical direction across teams through credibility and execution

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or enabling agentic or AI-driven workflows
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent integration patterns
  • Experience working in large-scale, distributed systems environments
  • Exposure to API governance, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility at scale
  • Experience working closely with the platform and SRE teams

title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:
Headquarters: Remote - California

 Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

 At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

 Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

 Read our blog to learn more.

 About the role...

 Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

 You will...

• Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.

• Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.

• Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.

• Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.

• Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.

• Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.

• Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

 You have...

• 8+ years of direct digital ad sales experience with a consistent track record of hunting, closing, and renewing in premium mobile or consumer app environments.

• Success selling video and native/custom formats and structuring innovative agreements with top‑tier advertisers and agencies.

• Proven ability to engage senior decision makers while rolling up your sleeves to build collateral, troubleshoot issues, and drive revenue personally.

• Strong understanding of ad tech and mobile app ecosystems, with skill using data to assess performance and inform pricing and packaging.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, and comfort operating with ambiguity at high velocity.

 ⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

• Established relationships across West Coast brand and agency decision makers.

• Experience introducing or scaling a new ads product from 0→1 within a publisher or platform environment.

• Experience shaping regional GTM, sales process, or coverage models beyond an individual book of business.

• Familiarity partnering with Account Management and Ad Ops on native/custom programs and live‑campaign storytelling to drive renewals.

• Vertical expertise in Entertainment, Gaming, Streaming, or Tech that accelerates early traction.

title: Chief of Staff, CCO
description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

 About Ping Identity:

 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

 We are seeking a strategic and analytical Chief of Staff to partner with our Chief Customer Officer (CCO) in driving business performance across our Customer organization. This role combines financial and operational strategy, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to improve customer retention, revenue performance, and organizational effectiveness.

 The ideal candidate brings strong financial and business acumen, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights that inform executive decisions and strengthen financial and operational accountability.

 What You'll Do

• Customer revenue metrics: In partnership with Finance, which owns ARR and financial reporting, to ensure customer metrics (ARR movement, gross and net revenue retention, renewal rates on up for renewal revenue, cohort views and churn drivers) follow Thoma Bravo standards and best-in-class methods. Translates those metrics into the customer organization's view, measures renewal forecast accuracy, and reports on cross-sell and upsell pipeline, which Renewals and Sales own.

• Executive and board narrative: Prepares the CCO's materials for the executive leadership team, board, Thoma Bravo operating reviews and QBRs, framing performance, risk and investment asks in terms of business outcomes. Ensures what the board sees reconciles to how the organization operates.

• Renewal and retention reporting: Owns renewal rate reporting and variance analysis of the official forecast against plan and actuals, explaining the drivers behind the numbers.

• Renewal and retention plan and resource models: In partnership with Finance, builds the customer organization's annual renewal and retention plan (historical baselines, renewal rate assumptions and targets) and the headcount, coverage-ratio and capacity models tied to book-of-business segmentation.

• Customer health and signals: Delivers the customer health scoring model and churn and risk analysis.

• Customer reporting requirements and CCO analysis: Sets the customer organization's reporting requirements across Salesforce, the data warehouse and BI tools, aligned with Finance's metric definitions, which Systems & Operations and Data & Analytics build to. Handles the CCO's own analysis and reporting requests.

• Cross-functional Alignment: Works with Revenue Operations and CRO leadership team to align on strategies and reporting for improving Net Retention Rate. Works with the Product Strategy team to align on churn analysis and forecasting by product.

 What You'll Bring

• Significant experience in strategic finance, FP&A, business operations, revenue operations, customer success operations, or a related field, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.

• Strong understanding of SaaS business models and recurring revenue metrics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, renewals, and churn.

• Experience translating business needs into reporting and analytics requirements, with familiarity using tools such as Salesforce, Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.

• Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate insights clearly to executive audiences.

• Familiarity with CRM, reporting, and business intelligence tools such as Salesforce, Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.

• Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence across teams.

• Experience in private equity-backed environments or supporting executive and board-level reporting is a plus.

 Salary Range: $155,628 - $207,504

 In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.
 Life at Ping:

 We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

 Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

 Our Benefits:

• Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule

• Parental Leave

• Progressive Healthcare Options

• Retirement Programs

• Opportunity for Education Reimbursement

• Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

 Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

 We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Federal Civilian
description:
Headquarters: US DC - Remote

 Asana's Vertical Go-to-Market team is looking for a driven, entrepreneurial, customer-centric, impact-oriented enterprise sales professional who holds themselves accountable to achieving results . You will join a dedicated team at Asana focused on serving our federal civilian customers . This role will focus on civilian federal agencies and departments, will be responsible for landing and expanding business within their book of business, and will help build out Asana's federal civilian go-to-market strategy overall .

 This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in any of our US offices with an office-centric hybrid schedule . If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays . Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner . If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements .

 What you’ll achieve

• Masterfully navigate complex federal account landscapes, leveraging data to optimize existing solutions and identify new use cases across civilian agencies .

• Anticipate procurement roadblocks and contracting objections with foresight, crafting solutions that ensure all stakeholders — from program officers to agency leadership — see the value of Asana .

• Drive revenue and grow business by navigating federal procurement vehicles (e.g., GSA schedules, BPAs, IDIQs) and data-driven insights to secure win-win partnerships .

• Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences, drive long-term mission impact, and deliver measurable business value .

• Serve as a trusted advisor with excellent relationship-building skills across all levels, from C-suite agency executives to end-users and program managers .

 About you

description:
Headquarters: Remote

 As a Customer Enablement Manager, you will partner with complex enterprise customers to transform how work gets done across their organizations. You will own a portfolio of strategic customers, providing a variety of enablement activities, including discovery, workflow consultation, change management, strategic enablement, and scalable education to accelerate adoption and measurable business outcomes.

 You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Services to understand customer priorities, diagnose barriers to adoption, and recommend strategies that help organizations adopt new workflows and AI-enabled ways of working. As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and help shape repeatable approaches that strengthen Asana's broader Customer Enablement practice.

 This role is West Coast based remote and is open to employees in Pacific or Mountain Standard time.

 What you'll achieve

• Strategic Trusted Advisory: Develop a deep understanding of customer business priorities, operating models, and ways of working. Lead discovery with complex stakeholders and translate customer challenges into clear recommendations for workflow, enablement, and adoption strategies that drive measurable business value.

• Own Complex Customer Engagements: Independently manage complex enterprise engagements within your portfolio of strategic customers, from discovery and planning through delivery, measurement, and follow-through. Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and multi-stakeholder environments while keeping engagements aligned to customer and account outcomes.

• Drive Workflow and AI Transformation: Help customers rethink how work gets done by translating Asana and AI capabilities into practical, scalable use cases. Guide customers through the people, process, and behavior change required to successfully adopt new ways of working.

• Executive and High-Impact Facilitation: Design and facilitate workflow consultations, strategic workshops, enablement programs, and executive-level conversations for audiences ranging from end users and champions to senior leaders. Adapt your approach based on customer maturity, organizational complexity, and desired outcomes.

• Measure and Optimize Customer Impact: Use adoption, engagement, and efficacy data to assess whether enablement is driving meaningful behavior change and business outcomes. Identify trends, adjust engagement strategies, and use insights to strengthen customer plans and CEM programs.

• Strengthen Customer Partnerships and Commercial Outcomes: Identify risks, expansion opportunities, and new use cases through your customer engagements. Partner with account teams to connect adoption and enablement strategies to retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to lead strategic conversations and high-impact sessions for audiences ranging from practitioners to executives.

• Strong project and portfolio management skills, with a track record of independently managing multiple complex customer engagements and driving work forward without significant oversight.

• Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of how adoption, customer value, retention, expansion, and organizational change are connected.

• Strong product and technical curiosity, with the ability to quickly develop expertise in new technology and translate AI and workflow capabilities into meaningful customer use cases.

title: Senior SRE - Networks
description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Senior SRE - Networks

Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity. Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously!

We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better.

What You'll Do:

  • Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform.

  • Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP.

  • Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise and contribute to code reviews, improving the codebase and other team processes

  • Partner in the development and iteration of tools and automation systems that improve how we operate and build the network.

  • Innovate new methods for monitoring network performance, focusing on the end-user experience, and proactively address potential issues.

  • Continual deep-dive of performance-based analytics and close involvement with partner teams to maintain a performant global network.

  • Advocate for the operational stability of the network by identifying opportunities and partnering with engineering teams to shape their roadmaps and software solutions.

  • Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience in the protocols and practices that make up the fabric of the global internet, including TCP/IP, BGP, Anycast and DNS.

  • Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers.

  • Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools.

  • Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk).

  • Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure).

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible).

  • Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation.

  • Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams.

  • Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

  • Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO

  • Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data

  • Experience working with geographically dispersed teams: previous remote work preferred

Work Hours:

  • This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 0800 - 1700.

  • This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

  • It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

This position has one opening and can be hired in the following locations:

  • London (Hybrid)

  • UK, Remote

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change.

Why Fastly?

  • We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

  • We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.

  • We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @fastly.com or @recruiting.fastly.com email address.

Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, family or parental status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal or state disability laws, Fastly will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at candidateaccommodations@fastly.com or 501-287-4901.

Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Please see our privacy notice for job applicants.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Data Intelligence)
description:
In this role, you’ll work closely with model researchers, data infrastructure engineers, and cross-functional partners to make sure our data is high quality and can be produced at petabyte scale in a reliable, efficient way. From understanding how data choices show up in model behavior, to building processing pipelines and running the compute behind them, you’ll help ensure our models are trained on the best data we can get.

  • Work with model researchers to define what “good data” means for our models, including quality metrics, validation checks, and acceptance thresholds

  • Explore open source datasets and create internal ones most suitable to build fundamental World Models

  • Build algorithms for automated data quality assessment, data domain mixtures, and domain adaptation from synthetic to real data.

  • Track datasets, metadata, provenance, and versions so experiments are reproducible and it’s clear what data went into which training and evaluation runs

  • Own CI/CD and development tooling for the data stack (GitHub, Python, PyTorch), and automate repetitive workflows to reduce friction

  • Comfortable moving between research questions and production engineering: you can dig into data, run analyses, and also ship reliable systems

  • Demonstrated research experience with data compositions, quality, and dataset releases

  • Ability to design and execute experiments with convincing unbiased outcomes

  • Practical experience with distributed processing and orchestration (Spark, Ray, Airflow, or equivalents)

  • Solid Python skills, and familiarity with the tooling around modern model training workflows (datasets, checkpoints, experiment tracking)

  • Strong instincts around data quality: how to measure it, how to monitor it, and how to prevent regressions as things scale

  • Able to work in a fast-moving environment, prioritize what matters, and communicate clearly with both researchers and engineers

title: Staff Android Engineer
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role

AlphaSense has spent more than a decade helping professionals find, trust, and synthesize market intelligence. With SuperAnalyst, we are expanding that foundation into continuous, decision-ready execution: workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile is a critical part of that future because the moments that matter do not only happen when customers are sitting at a desktop.

Android is an important surface for that future because continuous, decision-ready workflows need to feel fast, secure, and reliable across phones, foldables, and managed enterprise environments.

As a Staff Android Engineer, you will own and evolve the Android architecture and mobile-facing foundations that shape product quality across customer workflows. You will work from deep Android expertise while shaping the technical decisions, validation practices, and delivery patterns that help teams build reliable native experiences with confidence.

This is a hands-on Staff role with significant architectural ownership, platform-level leverage, and long-term product impact. You will help teams move faster while improving delivery predictability and preserving the quality, reliability, and trust that enterprise mobile experiences require, including by shaping the AI-enabled development, validation, and testing practices that make Android delivery safer and more confident.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the Android platform foundation: Define the Android architecture, modular boundaries, and native engineering patterns that make AlphaSense experiences fast, reliable, secure, and easier to evolve as the product grows.
  • Lead through hands-on Android system design:Turn complex product and platform problems into durable production architecture grounded in deep Android expertise and modern Android platform practices.
  • Improve reliability and delivery confidence: Shape how Android work is designed, reviewed, tested, shipped, and operated, including the automation, observability, rollout practices, and AI-enabled validation needed to move quickly with confidence.
  • Create clear mobile-facing system contracts: Partner with iOS, backend, product, and design to clarify API behavior, ownership boundaries, and platform expectations that protect native product quality without pushing hidden complexity into Android.
  • Raise mobile-system judgment across teams: Turn complex mobile-system work into reusable standards and stronger engineering judgment for the teams building native experiences.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Deep expertise in modern production Android architecture, with a track record of setting technical standards for a platform, product area, or native mobile domain.
  • Ability to represent mobile platform principles from a deep Android base, with enough iOS fluency to shape cross-functional architecture decisions where backend, web, and product choices affect identity, reliability, release quality, observability, and native product outcomes.
  • Experience shaping mobile-facing platform contracts, API behavior, or backend service boundaries that improve product quality across native client experiences.
  • Ability to read, debug, and make targeted contributions to backend systems when needed to unblock mobile-facing outcomes.
  • Experience shaping AI-enabled engineering systems that improve validation, product quality, and delivery confidence for Android and broader mobile outcomes.
  • Strong reliability and release-quality judgment across production mobile systems, with experience raising quality standards for a platform or product area.
  • Track record making engineers around you better by turning complex mobile-system work into clear standards, reusable patterns, and stronger technical judgment across teams.
  • Excellent product judgment and communication skills, including the ability to connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and align teams around durable technical decisions.

Preferred:

  • Experience building Android product experiences across varied device and form-factor contexts, such as foldables, wearables, Android Auto, or other platform-native surfaces.
  • Experience with enterprise mobile environments where identity, device management, compliance, or security constraints shape architecture, including MDM/EMM.
  • Experience shaping mobile design-system foundations and design-to-code workflows that improve consistency, accessibility, development velocity, and AI-assisted UI generation across native platforms.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Field marketing senior lead
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join Salesforce in London as the regional field marketing lead for our Platform business across EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and the UK and Ireland, including Agentforce and our security and developer services. You will own the full-funnel plan and the marketing-driven pipeline for the region, and build lasting relationships with senior security, IT and data leaders.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Set and deliver the regional field marketing strategy and quarterly plan, turning a significant program budget into measurable pipeline and revenue growth across events, digital and organic activity.
  • Design and host small, invite-only executive forums, CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) roundtables and Gartner executive summits that open doors for Agentforce and security-led deals.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, senior Sales leaders and the UK and Ireland field leader to agree on priorities, target accounts and follow-up, and report results with a clear business story.
  • Guide Field Marketing Analysts on workshops, webinars and digital programs, and manage agency and event partners, without direct line management.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 10 or more years of marketing experience, including field marketing, with a record of owning and delivering pipeline and revenue targets.
  • You have designed and delivered high-touch, in-person executive events and engaged C-level and senior technical buyers.
  • You have built strong alignment with Product Marketing and Sales leaders and can manage a budget, quarterly plan and KPIs independently across several markets.
  • Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.)

Even Better If...

  • You have security or technology marketing experience, including CISO or Gartner executive programs.
  • You have experience with CRM, campaign management and marketing reporting tools.
  • You have mentored junior colleagues.

Unleash Your Potential

This is a fixed-term contract for the duration of the 15‑month apprenticeship. Upon completion you will achieve a Level 3 Teaching Assistant qualification.

Under 18 years - £16,012 per annum

18-20 years - £21,510 per annum

Leeds City College are seeking an Apprentice Teaching Assistant to join our Printworks Campus.

This is a diverse, fast-paced and rewarding role which if focused on learner success and development, which supports learners from the start of their journey with us, until they leave it for their next steps and a successful progression into the next stage of their life.

As a supporter, advocate and coach for your caseload of learners, you will be ideally placed to drive success so that young people are able to realise their ambitions.

The Kingston Academy is seeking an enthusiastic, practical and organised technician to support our Art and Creative Industries faculty, which includes Textiles, Food Technology, Graphic Design and Resistant Materials.

In 2025, we were recognised as one of the Top 10 best non-selective state schools in the UK based on GCSE outcomes, reflecting our strong culture of aspiration, exceptional teaching, and commitment to every child’s success. Working within a collaborative team, the successful candidate will help maintain safe, well-equipped and inspiring learning environments, preparing resources, equipment and materials to support lessons and practical activities. Responsibilities across subject areas will be tailored to the candidate’s skills, experience and interests.

Previous school experience is desirable but not essential, as training and support will be provided. We are looking for a proactive, professional individual who shares our commitment to safeguarding, inclusion and supporting positive outcomes for pupils.

Our commitment extends not only to pupils but also to the people who work with them every day. We are dedicated to attracting, retaining and sustaining an expert workforce through high-quality talent development, ensuring that our staff are skilled, motivated and well supported. By investing in professional learning, coaching, wellbeing and leadership pathways, we ensure that our staff can flourish — and that our students benefit from consistently excellent teaching.

  • Is confident working with a range of tools, materials and equipment.

  • Ambition to develop each child to their maximum potential.

  • Flexible and approachable, resilient and calm under pressure, and demonstrate good judgement.

Benefits of working at The Kingston Academy:

  • Generous pay-scales, regularly paying 1% higher than National Support Staff Pay Scales;

  • 2-week October Half Term break;

  • Access to subsidised Cycle to Work scheme;

  • Weekly Professional Development sessions at whole-school and departmental level;

  • Generous pension scheme;

  • Subsidised study at Kingston University at Masters and Doctorate Level;

  • Flexible working arrangements may be considered on request;

  • Access to Employee Assistance Programme, subsidised eye test and flu vaccinations;

  • Work in a vibrant, supportive school environment where staff wellbeing is prioritised.

More details are available on the Candidate Information Pack, Job Description and Person Specification.

Interview Procedure

Our selection procedure will aim to identify with rigour whether the candidate fulfils the requirements of the post and will include the consideration of the candidate’s suitability to work with children and young people. The process will include:

  • Practical task;

  • Interview with Headteacher, Associate Headteacher and/or Senior Leaders.

Early applications are welcome, and we reserve the right to appoint before the closing date if we find a suitable candidate.

At Kingston Educational Trust, we believe that diversity enriches our school community and enhances the educational experience for all. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment that respects and celebrates the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and talents of our staff and students. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone. Join us in fostering a culture of diversity and inclusion where every individual is valued and empowered to thrive.

title: Farm and Estate Technician (Sheep)
company: Norwich City College of Further and Higher Education
description:
Farm and Estate Technician (Sheep)

37 hours per week, 52 weeks per year

£27,994 - £29,856 per annum

We are seeking an ambitious, motivated and conscientious applicant to join the Colleges Farm and Estate team and become the lead for the development and management of the 150-ewe sheep enterprise. This is a great opportunity for an individual to join a progressive team using modern practices, techniques and equipment across the 162ha (400acre) Estate and demonstrate their knowledge skills and techniques to students across the farming year. This is a hands-on role supporting the day-to-day care and management of our flock include grazing and forage planning, Lambing, flock health, record keeping and general estate upkeep, all while maintaining high standards of animal welfare, safety and farm presentation.

The sheep enterprise runs alongside a 180 head beef rearing unit, small suckler beef herd, crop production as well as onsite equine, small animal centres and a large outdoor pig farrowing unit. All managed using a regenerative, conservation focused system. The successful individual will have the opportunity to significantly shape their own role and enterprise but also help influence the other area they will be working alongside, all with the support of the Head of Easton Estate.

So, if you take pride in achieving high standards, want the opportunity to run and shape our sheep enterprise while passing on your skills, knowledge and experience to the future members of the land-based sector, then this could be the role for you.

About the Role:

  • Working closely with the Head of Estate, you will have full responsibility for the day-to-day running of the college flock, helping to ensure smooth, efficient and well organised livestock operations as well as freedom to shape the enterprise to contribute to the wider estate priorities.
  • Undertaking daily checks and feeding routines, bedding, managing breeding cycles and lambing, administering basic treatments or vaccinations and the use of mobile handling systems.
  • You will provide practical learning opportunities for students, including the demonstration of livestock husbandry and machinery skills to small groups.
  • Safely operating and maintaining tractors and telehandlers for feeding, bedding, and general field operations including forage production
  • Gather and record data on performance and update electronic records to ensure compliance with assurance schemes and Government legislation. (Agriwebb)
  • Work with other Estate technicians in the operation of the Colleges 160ha estate including Carrying out a wide range of seasonal farm and estate tasks to provide both demonstration to students and as part of the routine Estate management.

We are looking for the following key qualities:

  • Proven experience in sheep husbandry, management and health including lambing and livestock administration (Essential)
  • A passion for practical outdoor work and pride in achieving high standards.
  • Strong communication skills and an enthusiasm for the land-based sector.
  • The ability to work independently using your own initiative but also within a wider team when required.
  • A full UK driving licence. (Essential)
  • High expectations for safety, cleanliness and presentation.

title: Speech and Language Therapist
description:
Speech and Language Therapist

Location: Central role assigned to South Cumbria (Barrow-in-Furness)


Are you a passionate Speech and Language Therapist looking to transform outcomes for children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND)?

At Co-op Academies Trust, we are looking for a dedicated, forward-thinking Speech and Language Therapist to join our team in South Cumbria (Barrow-in-Furness). Many of our schools serve areas facing high levels of deprivation across the North of England. In this unique role, you won’t just manage a caseload—you will work alongside school staff, SENCOs, and external partners to build long-term capacity, upskill teaching teams, and create truly communication-friendly environments.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Deliver individual and group speech, language, and communication assessments and evidence-based interventions for pupils with complex needs, including Autism Spectrum Condition (ASC), ADHD, and sensory processing needs.
  2. Work closely with school SENCOs, teachers, and support staff to embed practical speech and language strategies across the wider curriculum.
  3. Design and deliver high-quality training and practical workshops for school staff, parents, and carers.
  4. Collaborate alongside existing NHS Speech and Language Therapy provisions to maximise support capacity across our primary and secondary academies.
  5. Contribute to Education, Health, and Care Plans (EHCPs), maintaining thorough records in accordance with HCPC and RCSLT standards.



What We Are Looking For

  1. Qualifications: Recognised Degree in Speech and Language Therapy and active registration with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).
  2. Experience: Proven experience working in inclusive educational settings with young people with SEND and complex learning or communication needs.
  3. Skills: Strong collaborative skills, expertise in Alternative and Augmentative Communication (AAC), ability to produce high-quality clinical reports, and a passion for empowering school staff.
  4. Values: A clear commitment to co-operative principles, inclusion, equal opportunities, and public service.


Why Choose Co-op Academies Trust?

  1. Values-Driven Culture: Guided by our Ways of Being Co-op (Do what matters most, Be yourself always, Show you care, Succeed together), we place ethics, equity, and community at the heart of everything we do.
  2. Dedicated Supervision & Professional Growth: Access clinical supervision, peer support networks, and ongoing continuous professional development (CPD).
  3. Competitive Employee Benefits: Local Government Pension Scheme, Co-op staff discounts, and access to a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits.

How to Apply

Ready to join an organisation dedicated to improving children's life chances? Please follow the online application process to be considered.

title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://www.workiva.com/latam/

 Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

 This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

 You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

 What you’ll do

• Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.

• Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.

• Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.

• Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.

• Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.

• Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.

• Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.

• Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.

• Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

 What you’ll need

 Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

 Preferred Qualifications

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.

• Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.

• Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.

• Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.

• A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.

• Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.

• Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.

• Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

 Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers

• Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

 How You’ll Be Rewarded

 ✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

 ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

 ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

 The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

 Why Join Workiva

 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

 At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

 Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

 Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com .

 Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

 Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

title: Staff Systems Engineer
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

Our InfoSec and IT teams are looking for a Staff Systems Engineer to lead and innovate at the intersection of infrastructure, security, and automation. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a digital-first, collaborative environment and is passionate about building resilient, secure, and scalable systems. You’ll be a technical leader across both our InfoSec and IT teams, driving the evolution of our systems landscape in both our Enterprise IT and Product environments. Your work will empower our global team of Paddlers to operate securely and efficiently, while ensuring that our systems not only meet but exceed industry standards.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead initiatives to automate operational processes, reducing manual effort and increasing reliability, with a focus on scalability and security.

  • Partner with IT and InfoSec leadership to design, implement, and optimise integrations across business-critical IT and security systems, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow.

  • Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code for our identity, network, and security tooling, including CI/CD pipelines for safe, auditable change delivery.

  • Champion compliance with industry best practices and security standards, including CIS Benchmarks, and proactively identify areas for improvement.

  • Support GRC initiatives on control implementation, audit evidence gathering and unlocking efficiency improvements through the adoption of automation.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver projects aligned with the Enterprise Technology roadmap, ensuring measurable impact and timely delivery.

  • Contribute to the secure configuration and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure and working with the Platform team to ensure security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

  • Develop and maintain internal documentation and knowledge bases to ensure consistent, high-quality support and operational excellence.

  • Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Have extensive experience in one or more of systems engineering, site reliability engineering, security engineering, or software development with a strong track record of hands-on delivery in both IT and security domains.

  • Are comfortable working collaboratively across multiple business functions, and can operate autonomously on high-impact and wide-reaching projects.

  • Can demonstrate strong knowledge of systems integration and automation, with a passion for reducing operational complexity and driving continuous improvement.

  • Have awareness of industry standards and frameworks (such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, PCI DSS), and experience implementing compliance controls in real-world environments.

  • Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity management, resource configuration, and monitoring. Hands-on experience working with AWS infrastructure, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployment paradigms is highly desirable.

  • Are familiar with modern device management, IAM, and EDR solutions (e.g., Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

  • Have a software engineering background (desirable), with experience in scripting or programming to automate workflows and integrate systems.

  • Hands-on experience writing and operating Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform strongly preferred) for identity, network, or cloud security systems.

  • Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business.

  • Are passionate about security, automation, and operational excellence, and want to make a real impact at scale.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.
